## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich bin in meinem Element.** — [ikh bin in MY-nem eh-leh-MENT] — *I'm in my element.*
2. **Das spricht mich an.** — [das shprikht mikh AHN] — *That appeals to me / resonates with me.*
3. **Lass es auf dich wirken.** — [lahss es owf dikh VEER-ken] — *Let it sink in / Let it work on you.*
